notablePrerequisites: Illusionist's Bracers attached to Tymora's Invoker.
description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tymora's Invoker's ability.
Resolve the first ability, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
